name: LA LLUVIA DE CONFETI
note: Proposal. The rain of confetti: a samba no pé in the feet, then the hands throwing confetti high on the off-beats, left, right, left, right, then the feet again and a stamp. Her moves are her own clips (choreography.json dancers.purpurina), each a whole number of loops: lluvia_open (1.75 beats) on 0-1.75, confetti_rain (0.75 beats, a scoop then a throw on its last quarter) five times on 1.75-5.5 so every throw lands on a hand note, and lluvia_close (2.5 beats) on 5.5-8 with the right foot on 6 and the stamp on 7. WIRE2's notes, unchanged: every gap is at least three quarters of a beat, 402 ms at 112 BPM. The owner hasn't seen or played it.
